path.title: Path
path.description: Path of the file relative to the node's directory.

content.title: Content
content.description: Full text content of the file; empty for a binary file.

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: The file isn't UTF-8 text (a SQLite database, an image), so it is listed without its content - /api/download_node_file has its bytes.

size.title: Size
size.description: A binary file's size in bytes.

files.title: Files
files.description: Every file in the node's directory but node_config.json: main.lua and any loose files (e.g. samples), text with its content, binary files without.
